entries.original_title: Biomechanical remodeling of the microenvironment by stromal caveolin-1 favors tumor invasion and metastasis

entries.description: Stromal Cav1 expression affects primary tumor growth of LM-4175 breast cancer cells in vivo
entries.citation_sentence: The comparisons of the primary tumor growth between the three groups of mice, LM-4175 cells injected with or without Cav1WT or Cav1KO pMEFs, which were reported in Figure 2A of this study and Supplemental Figure 7Ca of Goetz et al. (2011), were in the same directions between the two studies and the effect size point estimate of each study was within the CI of the other study (Figure 4A).
entries.notes: Authors explicitly state primary tumor growth 'does not change when Cav1 is absent in the tumor stroma'; meta-analysis p=0.467; all three planned comparisons non-significant.

entries.description: Stromal Cav1 expression increases metastatic burden of LM-4175 breast cancer cells in vivo
entries.citation_sentence: There were three comparisons of total metastasis formation between the three groups, which was reported in Figure 2C of this study and Figure 7Cb of Goetz et al. (2011).
entries.notes: Authors summarize metastasis results as 'not in the same direction as the original study and not statistically significant' for the planned comparisons; however, the LM-4175 vs LM-4175 plus Cav1KO meta-analysis was significant (p=0.0027) in the same direction as the original, creating ambiguity.

entries.description: Stromal Cav1 expression increases intratumoral fibronectin fiber alignment
entries.citation_sentence: There were two comparisons of fibronectin fiber orientation, which was reported in Figure 3A of this study and Supplemental Figure 7Cc of Goetz et al. (2011).
entries.notes: Authors state results were 'in the same direction as the original study and not statistically significant where predicted'; LM-4175 plus Cav1WT vs LM-4175 plus Cav1KO meta-analysis was significant (p=1.11×10−4) but LM-4175 vs LM-4175 plus Cav1WT was not (p=0.269).

entries.description: Intratumoral fibronectin fiber alignment is positively correlated with metastatic burden
entries.citation_sentence: Finally, the rank-order correlation that was determined in both studies to determine the association of fibronectin fiber orientation and total metastasis for all three groups, LM-4175 cells injected with or without Cav1WT or Cav1KO pMEFs, reported in Figure 3C of this study and Figure 7Cd of Goetz et al. (2011), were not consistent when considering direction of the effect (Figure 4D).
entries.notes: Original reported a statistically significant positive correlation; replication found a statistically significant negative correlation (rs=−0.50, p=0.025); authors explicitly describe results as 'statistically significant in the opposite direction as the original study'; meta-analysis not significant (p=0.837) with significant heterogeneity (Cochran's Q p=2.13×10−5).
